mentions.name: Vaporview
mentions.description: A digital waveform viewer extension for VS Code, built for debugging hardware designs such as soft CPUs, starting to rival proprietary waveform software.
mentions.problem: The author needed to debug soft CPUs while working at an FPGA company, where the alternatives were proprietary waveform software.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a digital waveform viewer for VScode. I started it back when I used to work for an FPGA company, and needed to debug soft CPUs. Now it's starting to rival the proprietary software.
